purpose: Find the existing owner and affected scope before a global edit. Symbol calls come from the TypeScript compiler graph, not text matching. Record-owned intrinsic page scope remains explicit. Shared-style routes are conservative potential scope; runtime and visual acceptance remain separate.

limitations: Static symbol calls and reverse file closure describe potential affected routes, not proof every conditional renders.
Computed fetch/configuration, selector matching/inheritance and browser behavior need runtime evidence.
CSS parsing inventories flat declaration blocks conservatively; it is not a full CSS cascade resolver.
